infos.urlText: T1 Western Line: Some trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern. City Circle trackwork may also affect how you travel
infos.content:
Saturday 7 and Sunday 8 November
  • Richmond trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern between Richmond and Olympic Park. You may need to change trains to continue your journey.
Trackwork on the City Circle may also affect how you travel
  • Trains do not run around the City Circle but continue to run between Central and Wynyard.
  • For travel to Circular Quay, St James or Museum use light rail, local buses or walk.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
infos.subtitle: T1 Western Line: Some trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern. City Circle trackwork may also affect how you travel

infos.content:
From Sunday to Thursday, between 10pm and 5am, ceiling installation works will take place in the pedestrian tunnel between platforms 4 and 11 and the lower concourse.
 - During this time, the Redfern end stairs on Platforms 4 to 11 will be closed.
 - Customer will need to use the City end of the platform to exit via the Grand Concourse.
 - If you need assistance, ask station staff or call 9379 1777.
infos.subtitle: Station Update - Central

infos.content:
Access Restriction 
Central Station - Entry & Exit to Chalmers Street near the Dental Hospital Is closed until further notice.
infos.subtitle: Station Update - Central

infos.urlText: From Wednesday 4 November, some bus services in Sydney’s Eastern Suburbs, Northern Beaches, lower North Shore and inner north-west may be affected by industrial action.
infos.content:
From Wednesday 4th November, some services may be affected by industrial action which involves drivers not operating certain vehicles.  
Buses may be delayed or cancelled and there may be longer wait times and crowding at major interchanges.  
Plan ahead, allow extra travel time and consider travelling outside peak periods where possible.
infos.subtitle: From Wednesday 4 November, some bus services in Sydney’s Eastern Suburbs, Northern Beaches, lower North Shore and inner north-west may be affected by industrial action.
